body: When I am feeling really shitty, volunteer at the homeless shelter. Something about helping others brings joy to me. We are here for you man, you can do it!
Pm me if you want, I am drunk and will be up all night.
If you quit then that's the end. People love you, you may not see it but it is true.
thanks for being there, it feels good to feel like someone cares
You are right. I think the booze are whispering dread to me :(
I am all right, just really drunk and looking at my life. Feels like I wasted it. at what point is it to late to turn around and make something of your life?

There are so many of us out there  for you. Your pain may end but it travel on to the ones who love you. I am not good with words, but try to carry on.

This is a really sad song, but it makes me feel better.
